Commentary.Commentary: Adil Rashid got 2 but gave 51 in his quota of 10 overs. His spin partners Root and Ali did well with the former scalping one to his name as well. The pacers did very well as everyone ticked the wicket column. The stats say, England have lost their last 5 ODIs at this venue and Pakistan will be happy of the fact. But the question is will Pakistan make it 6 for the home side? We saw the rains coming down during the first innings but it didn't waste much of our time. We really hope for it to stay away so that we get to see full second innings without any delay. Join us back shortly for the run chase...

Sarfraz Ahmed registered a fifty to his name and once that happened, Pakistan lost two quick wickets. Malik did well to rotate the strike but fell prey to Plunkett. Had Sarfraz or Malik been there till the last over, you never know they might have got around 275 as well. But nonetheless, a good show from Azhar's men with the willow. For England, they will be pretty much happy with their efforts. Everybody was pretty economical and provided breakthroughs as and when it was needed for the side.

Azhar Ali got good support from Babar Azam and the duo stitched a 61-run stand between them before the latter got out. Sarfraz Ahmed then walked in and continued the good work with his skipper and threaded another 65-run stand with him. Azhar Ali in the quest to continue the run flow threw his wicket but not before playing a captain's knock.

A fine comeback from England to restrict Pakistan to a total that somewhat looks under their grasp. But as they say, don't judge anything until both teams have batted. It all started with Pakistan winning the toss but didn't get the best of the starts as the star against Ireland, Sharjeel Khan got out early. Hafeez couldn't do much either but it was the skipper Azhar Ali who kept a hold at one end.

Short of a length delivery outside off, Khan looks to defend but gets a bottom edge on that one.
Length ball on off, Ali opens the face of the bat and guides it down to third man for a single.

That's a risky single! On a length and outside off, Sharjeel Khan taps it into the ground and wanted a single immediately. He was running towards the danger end. Woakes tries to kick the ball onto the stumps but it doesn't hit. Replays show it would been a close call had that it.
Covers the line and defends it gently off the front foot towards covers.

A shout for lbw, it's turned down! On a length and gets it to nip back in sharply. Ali gets on the front foot to defend but gets an inside edge on the pads. They all go up in an appeal but the umpire says not out. Replays show it was pitched outside the line.
Wide! Bowls it a touch wide outside off, it's been left alone. Wide called by the umpire.
Bowls it from wide of the crease and angles this one on the pads, Azhar flicks it towards mid-wicket for a couple.
Short of a length delivery on off, Ali ducks under it in sanity.
Angles a length delivery on middle and off, Azhar punches it back to the bowler.
On a length and outside off, Khan guides it towards backward point and scampers across for a quick single.
Angles a length delivery on the pads, clipped down to fine leg for a single to keep strike.
In the channel on off, SK leaves it for the keeper behind.
On a length and outside off, dabbed towards third man.
Gets behind the line and taps it on the off side for no runs.

FOUR! Top edge and it's into the fence! Short of a length delivery, wide outside off. Ali reaches out to that one and ends up getting a thick top edge which goes flying over the slip cordon for a boundary.
Good length ball on off, defended off the back foot.
Lovely ball! On a length and outside off, nips in a bit after pitching. Sharjeel looks to defend but gets beaten up.
FOUR! Just past the timber! Short of a length delivery, very close to the off stick. Khan looks to cut but gets a thick inside edge past the leg pole to the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Short of a length delivery on middle, Khan ducks to evade it.

FOUR! Pulled away in disdain! Tad short and on middle, comes up at a nice height too. Sharjeel Khan gets back and pulls it hard through mid-wicket. No need to run for those. With that Pakistan are off the mark.
On a good length and outside off, Sharjeel looks to defend but the ball just whizzes past his outside edge to the keeper.

A loud shout for lbw! Slants this on the pads, Khan looks to flick it across the line but misses and is hit on the pads. The ball lobs towards the off side and they appeal for an lbw. It's not given as it was pitched outside leg.
MARK WOOD will share the second new ball from the other end!
On a length and around off, not much movement this time. Ali taps it towards the off side. A maiden to start the proceedings.
Full and angling in this time, Ali looks to defend but gets an inside edge on the pads.
Good stop from Stokes! Short of a length delivery on off, Ali cuts it towards point where Roy dives to his left and stops a single for his side. Pakistan are still not off the mark.
Keeps it full this and bowls it slightly outside off, Ali drives it to the left of the bowler.
Back of a length delivery on off, Ali gets back and defends it towards covers.
Starts with a length delivery, moving away a bit. Ali shoulders his arms to that one.

We are all set for the game to start. The umpires and players have made their way out to the middle. It will be AZHAR ALI and SHARJEEL KHAN who will open the batting for the Men in Green. CHRIS WOAKES will start off with the bowling proceedings with two slips in place...
ENGLAND PLAYING XI - Alex Hales, Jason Roy, Joe Root, Eoin Morgan (c), Ben Stokes, Jos Buttler (wk), Moeen Ali, Chris Woakes, Adil Rashid, Liam Plunkett, Mark Wood.
PAKISTAN PLAYING XI - Azhar Ali (c), Sharjeel Khan, Mohammad Hafeez, Babar Azam, Shoaib Malik, Sarfraz Ahmed (wk), Mohammad Nawaz, Imad Wasim, Wahab Riaz, Mohammad Amir, Umar Gul.
MORGAN SPINS THE COIN. AZHAR CALLS IT CORRECTLY. PAKISTAN WILL BAT!

The Test series is done and dusted and it's now time for the ODI series to get underway. England last met Sri Lanka where they just outclassed them and come this time they would look to repeat the same. Pakistan on the other hand are coming from a thunderous performance against Ireland and will be under the leadership of Azhar Ali. Showers are expected later in the evening and we can only hope for it to stay away so that we can get a full fledged play. Toss and team news coming up in a short while...
